name: Tennessee
notes: No broad-based individual income tax on earned income. Federal income tax and self-employment tax still apply in full.

against.title: Tennessee Department of Revenue, Hall Income Tax: the tax on interest and dividends was phased out and is fully repealed for tax years beginning January 1, 2021; it never applied to salaries or wages
Tenn. Const. art. II, sec. 28 (amended November 4, 2014): the legislature shall not levy, authorize or otherwise permit any state or local tax upon payroll or earned personal income
